title: Pearl CTF
description:
Pearl CTF is being organized by CyberLabs, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
The CTF will consist of challenges from various categories like Web exploitation, Pwn, Forensics, Reverse Engineering, Cryptography,  Blockchain, Game etc.

Challenges come in a variety of difficulties. There is something for everyone.

Hope you have fun. Happy hacking!

Timeline:
8th March 17:30 - 10th March 05:30 (IST)

Duration:
36 hours
prizes:
Top 3 Teams Stand to Win:
1st Place - 30000 INR / $ 365
2nd Place - 20000 INR / $ 245
3rd Place - 10000 INR / $ 125

Meme Competition:
Additionally, Exciting HTB Coupons await for the Masters of Memes!
